solutions.title: Heap cycle simulation
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly schedule up to n + 1 currently most frequent task labels, reinserting labels that still have work.

timeComplexity.explanation: T scheduled/idle slots each touch a heap of U distinct labels.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The heap stores one counter per label.

solutions.title: Frequency frame formula
solutions.strategy: Use the maximum frequency to count mandatory frames, then compare against the raw task count.

timeComplexity.explanation: Count tasks once and scan the U label counts.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Frequency counts are stored for distinct labels.
